newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Banking stock MCB pushes Mauritius share index up.
newsitem.headline: Banking stock MCB pushes Mauritius share index up.

text.p: Leading stock Mauritius Commercial Bank (MCB) pushed up the bourse index Semdex by 0.71 points to 361.84 on Monday in an otherwise stable market.
Brokers said the volume transacted totalled 26.65 million rupees on 973,922 shares from 5.79 million rupees on 361,746 shares last Friday.
MCB edged up 50 cents to 85.50 rupees on 181,034 shares, making up a little more than 50 percent of the day's total deals.
"There has been interest in the MCB shares as last week's published interim financial results showed the bank has made an above average performance," one broker said.

MCB reported a 15 percent rise in interim profit before tax of 408.0 million rupees ($20.3 million) for the six months ended 31 December 1996 from 354.5 million rupees during the corresponding period in 1995.
"Foreign investors showed big concern in the MCB shares, that's why a big volume of shares have been traded," said another broker.

The other major share on the move was national carrier Air Mauritius which gained 1.40 rupees to 37.20 rupees on 14,780 shares. Air Mauritius, whose shares dived by 24 percent in two weeks in March after the airline forecast a slump in profits, was seen as attracting interests from bargain hunters.
Stocks in the rest of the market were mostly stable.

Conglomerate Rogers was unchanged at 99.00 rupees on 50,965 shares. Ireland Blyth was stable at 14.60 rupees on 7,810 shares despite reporting a pre-tax profit fall of 60 percent to 20.1 million rupees for 1996.

"This result was already discounted by the market. While releasing its 1995 figures last year, Ireland Blyth had already made it widely known that its 1996 profits would not be brilliant either," one broker said.
In the investment sector, Policy remained at 4.05 rupees on heavy volume of 603,000 shares. Sugar concern Mon Tresor Mon Desert was unchanged at 38.00 rupees on 3,790 shares.
